Poppy|sup.identity: Anti-dive tank. Iron Ambassador (passive): she throws her buckler, which bounces off the target; picking it up gives her a shield. Hammer Shock (Q) slams her hammer and leaves a zone that slows, then explodes, Steadfast Presence (W) passively gives her resistances and, when activated, speed while stopping the dashes of enemies around her, Heroic Charge (E) charges a target to knock it back (stun against a wall), and Keeper's Verdict (R) channels a hammer swing that launches enemies very far away.
Poppy|sup.playstyle: Counter-engage support: she stops dashes with W, stuns against walls with E and sends divers far away from her team with her ultimate. She crushes dive supports (Camille, Pantheon, Pyke) and struggles against enchanters who poke her from range (Janna, Zilean, Sona).
Poppy|sup.early_game: Play around walls: Heroic Charge (E) stuns your opponent if you knock them into a wall. Keep Steadfast Presence (W) to stop the enemy dash or hook. Pick up your buckler after every empowered attack for the shield.
Poppy|sup.level_1: Heroic Charge (E) first. After that, max Q first.
Poppy|sup.level_2: Hammer Shock (Q). Combo: E into a wall → Q → attacks.
Poppy|sup.level_3: Steadfast Presence (W). Stops enemy dashes around you: cast it when an engage is coming.
Poppy|sup.level_6: Keeper's Verdict: when charged, it launches very far (away from your team = perfect disengage). A quick swing (uncharged) launches less far but can also separate a diver from your carry.
power_spikes: Level 2: E into a wall + Q.
Teamfights: W in the middle of the enemy divers.
Poppy|sup.lane_plan: Shut down enemy engages with W, look for stuns against walls. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Poppy|sup.trading: All-in: E into a wall → Q → attacks (pick up the buckler). Defense: W against dashes, E to knock back the diver, R to send them far away. Against enchanters who poke you (Janna, Zilean), don't force it: play for counter-engages.
threats: Ranged poke: you have to get close to be useful.
mistakes: Using E far from any wall (no stun).
Casting W too early, before the enemy dash.
Launching an enemy toward their team with your ultimate instead of away from it.

matchup_notes.Thresh: W stops his hook when he dashes toward his ADC.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: Keep W for the moment his anchor pulls him toward you.
matchup_notes.Alistar: W stops his charge: don't let him reach you.
matchup_notes.Pyke: His dash (E) is stopped by your W.
matchup_notes.Janna: She knocks you back and pokes you: play defensively.

Poppy|sup.mid_game: Protect your ADC and jungler, place Control Wards and look for wall stuns around objectives.
Poppy|sup.late_game: Stay near your carry: W when divers arrive, E to knock them back, R to send the most dangerous one far from the fight.
Poppy|sup.ahead: Engage with E into walls and take objectives.
Poppy|sup.behind: Play anti-dive: your W and ultimate protect your carry.
Poppy|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to stop enemy dives and keep your carry alive.
Poppy|sup.final_tip: Steadfast Presence stops every dash around you: cast it the moment your opponent jumps, not before.
